description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git merge and checkout error messages. It sets up various repository states and verifies that appropriate error messages are generated when attempting operations that should fail due to untracked files, local changes, or directory conflicts.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Executes a test that is expected to succeed, setting up the repository state, running commands, and verifying outputs.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command that must fail, typically capturing its error output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output files or streams against expected content.
